featured.title: 12.12: The Day
featured.subtitle: A coup d'etat that shook a nation in the winter of 1979.

movies.title: Lust Stories 3 (2026)
movies.description: Through four bite-sized yet emotionally resonant films, the anthology once again explores lust, love, relationships, and repressed desire, offering fresh perspectives on intimacy, longing, and human connection in all their complexity.

movies.title: The End of Oak Street (2026)
movies.description: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

movies.title: Resident Evil (2026)
movies.description: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

movies.title: Street Fighter (2026)
movies.description: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

movies.title: Jailer 2 (2026)
movies.description: When a dangerous syndicate expands its reach to threaten his family's peace, retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian goes undercover as a driver. Operating from the shadows, he takes on ruthless new enemies to protect his home.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
movies.description: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

movies.title: Colony
movies.description: Professor Se-jeong is thrust into a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus is released during a biotech conference causing authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations.
Yoon-young, a 19-year-old girl who dreams of becoming a civil servant, is framed as a murderer and imprisoned in a women's prison.

movies.title: A Tale of Two Sisters
movies.description: Two sisters return home after a stay in a mental institution, only to face disturbing events and a strained relationship with their stepmother. As eerie occurrences unfold, dark family secrets begin to surface, blurring the line between reality and nightmare.

movies.title: A Man and a Woman
movies.description: Two strangers have dropped their kids off at a pickup area for a children's camp in Helsinki, Finland. A spark of mutual interest is ignited between the man and woman.

movies.title: A Hard Day
movies.description: After trying to cover up a car accident that left a man dead, a crooked homicide detective is stalked by a mysterious man claiming to have witnessed the event.

movies.title: A Company Man
movies.description: A contract killer becomes disenchanted with his line of work and spares the lives of his two latest would-be-victims. But the assassination company he works for has no intentions of letting him quit.

movies.title: 20th Century Girl
movies.description: In 1999, a teen girl keeps close tabs on a boy in school on behalf of her deeply smitten best friend – then she gets swept up in a love story of her own.

movies.title: 12.12: The Day
movies.description: On December 12, 1979, in Seoul, South Korea, military officers staged a military rebellion following the assassination of President Park Chung-hee. Defense Security Commander Chun Doo-gwang leads an unauthorized insurrection to seize control of the military and government, while stubborn Capital Defense Commander Lee Tae-shin risks his life to resist the treason and defend the republic.

series.title: Love in Disguise (Ongoing)
series.description: [Ongoing Series - 2 Episodes Released] Taekang Group's successor, Yoon Yi-jun, is the prime suspect of a shocking murder. To uncover the truth, Kang Jae-hee goes undercover as a male secretary to keep an eye on Yi-jun. The closer they get to what really happened, the closer Yi-jun and Jae-hee become. Will Jae-hee, who is hiding her identity, and Yi-jun, who is hiding a secret, be able to let their true feelings be known to one another?

episodes.title: Episode 01 - Episode 1
episodes.overview: Taekang Group's successor, Yoon Yi-jun, is suspected of murdering his secretary, but the group's power and lack of evidence impede the investigation. To find key evidence, special forces-turned-detective Kang Jae-hee applies to be his secretary, not as a woman but as a man! She manages to get the job, but Yi-jun doesn't let his guard down. Jae-hee risks getting exposed on her first day at work.

episodes.title: Episode 02 - Episode 2
episodes.overview: Kang Jae-hee's double life begins. She's Yoon Yi-jun's secretary by day and a detective by night. Yi-jun keeps testing her, but Jae-hee relentlessly keeps an eye on him and searches for the missing phone. She plans to infiltrate the room that's banned from entering, but Yi-jun doesn't let his guard down easily. Their relationship takes a strange turn through unexpected physical contact.

series.title: A Killer Paradox
series.description: When one accidental killing leads to another, an ordinary young man finds himself stuck in an endless cat-and-mouse chase with a shrewd detective.

series.title: 7 First Kisses
series.description: Min Soo Jin meets a goddess who allows her to choose one guy among seven as her first kiss.

episodes.title: Episode 04: Till the End of the World
Episode 05: I'm Your Teacher, You’re My Student
Episode 07: How to Fall in Love With a Celebrity

series.title: 365: Repeat the Year
series.description:
A story where ten people get the chance to go back in time by one year, but unexpectedly mysterious situations start to arise when their fates are changed and twisted in the process.

Ji Hyung Joo is a detective in the violent crimes division. He used to be part of the traffic police but was promoted when he arrested a wanted criminal.

It's been seven years since the change, and he's a talented individual who always knows how to relax. Though he is happy at first to have the chance to go back in time by one year and "reset" his life, he begins to search for the truth when a series of mysterious events befall on the group of people he goes back in time with. Based on the Japanese novel, "Repeat"

series.title: 28 Faces of the Moon
series.description: The drama tells the story of a man whose life takes a downward spiral after his fiance dies just days before their upcoming marriage.

series.title: 20th Century Boy and Girl
series.description: The heartwarming romantic comedy is about the friendship and love lives of three single virgins born in 1983. Their romantic lives begin when the boy they liked in their youth shows up one day. They live in Oksu-dong in rundown apartments, and the warm human drama will be about neighborly affection, and the meaning of home, family, and friendship.

series.title: 100 Days My Prince
series.description: Lee Yool falls off a cliff and nearly dies in an attempted assassination. He loses his memory, and wanders for 100 days under a new name and personality. During this period, he meets Hong Sim, head of the first detective agency in Joseon.

series.title: 18 Again
series.description: At a difficult place in his marriage and career, a 37-year-old middle-aged man on the brink of divorce gets a miraculous shot at a do-over when he is transformed back into his 18-year-old high school body.

upcoming.title: Avengers: Doomsday
upcoming.description: Beloved heroes from distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.
